address: 2-2-18/15/C, Plot no -10 Durgabai Deshmukh colony, Bagh Amberpet, Hyderabad, Telangana 500007, India

reviews.text: Tried these fresh organic sapota fruits from the NastroBlu shop — naturally grown without fertilizers and straight from an organic farm. The taste was incredibly sweet and fresh. I'm usually not much of a fruit person, but they were so good I finished them quickly. Highly recommend for anyone looking for clean, farm-fresh produce.
The dry fruit laddu is outstanding — no artificial colours or essence, just real ingredients. We ordered a box for festival gifting and everyone asked where it was from. Will definitely buy again.
Cold pressed oils from Nastro Blu are a staple in our kitchen now. You can smell the difference as soon as you open the bottle. Honest pricing and friendly store staff in Bagh Amberpet.
Ajmeri kalakand was soft, fresh and not overly sweet. Tasted exactly like homemade. Loved that they let us sample before buying — true to their 'taste before you buy' promise.
Motichoor laddu and the traditional sweets are made without silver leaf or preservatives. Rare to find such clean-label sweets in Hyderabad. Packaging was neat for travel too.
Came for Kerala spices and left with honey and ghee as well. Everything feels carefully sourced. Google rating is well deserved — worth a visit if you care about what goes into your food.
